title: Scam spotter
intro: Real-looking messages, one at a time. Is it a scam, or is it safe?
cardText: Scam or safe? Test your eye

parcel.text: Your parcel is waiting. Pay a 1.99 € customs fee here within 24 h: parcel-delivery-help.info
parcel.why: A surprise fee, a deadline and a strange link. Real delivery companies tell you about fees in their own app or website.

skins.text: Claim 5000 free coins today only! Log in with your game account at free-skins-gift.net
skins.why: Free stuff plus a login on another site is how accounts get stolen. Only log in inside the game or its official site.

library.text: Are we still meeting at 4 at the library?
library.why: A normal message from someone you know, with no link, no money and no rush.

update.text: We have released an update. Please update the app from your phone's official app store.
update.why: No link, nothing to type in, and it sends you to the official store yourself. Still, go there on your own rather than through any link.

mentor.text: I turned 100 € into 5000 € in one week. Send me 50 € and I'll show you how.
mentor.why: A stranger promising huge profits and asking you to pay first. Classic.

mum.text: Hi, my phone broke, this is my new number. Can you send me 50 € quickly? Don't call, I can't talk now.
mum.why: A "new number", money in a hurry and "don't call". Call the real number you already have before doing anything.

sportsDay.text: Reminder: sports day is on Friday. Bring a water bottle and good shoes!
sportsDay.why: Information only. No link, no money, nothing to log in to.

verify.text: Unusual login detected. Verify your wallet by entering your 12-word recovery phrase within 24 hours or it will be locked.
verify.why: No real service ever asks for your seed phrase. The deadline is there to scare you.

gg.text: gg! want to play another round?
gg.why: Just a friendly game message. Nothing asked from you.

giveaway.text: Congrats, you won a new phone! Just pay the 5 € shipping fee to receive it.
giveaway.why: You can't win a contest you didn't enter. "Pay a small fee to get your prize" is a scam.

card.text: A card payment of 12.50 € at a café was approved. If this wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card.
card.why: No link and no request for codes. It tells you to use the number you already have on your card.

job.text: Easy money! Receive payments to your bank account, send them on and keep 10%.
job.why: This is how criminals move stolen money through young people's accounts. It is illegal and can get your account closed.
